sourceNote: RFC 9248 Figure 2 illustrates entryPoint, while the normative Section 9.3.1 OpenAPI schema requires providerEntryPoint. RFC 9248 states that the OpenAPI description takes precedence on conflict, so this fixture follows providerEntryPoint.
claimBoundary: Reserved example domains and invented provider labels only. This fixture does not represent a production VRS provider directory or assert RFC 9248 deployment by any provider.
